messages:
Aisha Patel: Quick ping — we're 2 mins from the all-hands. AV team says the ingest into us-west is intermittent. Can we confirm backup plan so leadership Q&A isn't interrupted?
Priya Rao: AV is flagging packet loss to the CDN. Tom, can you run the local backup & let hosts know about any caption lag?
Tom Becker: Yep. I'll start local OBS and also enable local SRT out to 10.8.7.6:9000. Will mirror the stream.
Marta Silva: Hosts: please pause ~2s after slide changes if captions get laggy. I'll announce in the room.
ops-bot: Warning: recorder-us-west latency spike detected. 5xx rate increased by 18% over 1m. Event ID: REC-WS-2145.
Lina Ortega: On the roadmap Qs: Aisha, folks keep asking whether Q3 infra work delays the model-serving rollout. Can you clarify in the talk?
Aisha Patel: Yes — we'll cover that in the roadmap section. TL;DR: infra work shifts some Dedicated capacity launches by 3 weeks, but no change to our Hosted SLAs.
Priya Rao: Tom, once OBS + SRT are live, post the temp URL here and we'll switch the mixer input. Also add a note in the retro doc with the time you flipped routes.
Tom Becker: OBS recording live. Local SRT to 10.8.7.6:9000 active. Test clip uploaded: https://files.internal/redwood/tmp/hb9k2.mp4
Marta Silva: Thanks. Hosts briefed. I added a slide that mentions the caption offset and will call it out during transitions.
Lina Ortega: For follow-ups: can we get a short Q&A doc after the all-hands summarizing action items? I'll collate and tag owners.
Aisha Patel: Yes please. Label items as "ownership: team" and add target ETA. We'll review at leadership sync.
Priya Rao: Ops — please capture the recorder error logs and add to incident tracker with root-cause hypothesis. We'll add the persistent fallback to the runbook after this meeting.
ops-bot: Logged: incident REC-WS-2145 created by Priya Rao. Attach logs: https://incidents.internal/REC-WS-2145
Tom Becker: Mixer input switched to local SRT at 2145670038. Monitoring — packets stable for 25s.
Aisha Patel: Great work, team. During Q&A, I'll ask folks to surface any downstream customer impacts if they saw degraded recordings. We'll debrief post-meeting. :raised_hands:
